figures.explanation: Validation slice (500 held-out GSM8K train items x 2 samples, one GPU for every model): accuracy against reasoning budget 256 to 8,192 tokens for the untouched model, the shared format warm-up and each arm (thick line = mean of its seeds, thin = single seeds). Area under the curve: untouched 0.728; warm-up 0.838; ctrl 0.896 (seeds 0.895/0.896); wide 0.888 (seeds 0.888); wide1 0.896 (seeds 0.896/0.894/0.899). The arms start from the warm-up, so the warm-up curve is the bar: an arm above it at small budgets got more accuracy for fewer reasoning tokens. PARTIAL: 6 of 9 arm runs present (ctrl seeds 0/1, wide seeds 0, wide1 seeds 0/1/2); redrawn as runs finish, no arm verdict until 3 seeds per arm.

Validation slice (500 held-out GSM8K train items x 2 samples, one GPU for every model): every pre-registered contrast on the primary metric, as the seed-mean difference in area with its paired item bootstrap 95% interval and the single-seed differences. Rule: an arm effect needs all 3 seeds with the same sign and an interval that excludes 0; warm-up minus untouched has one readout per side, so it is descriptive. wide - ctrl -0.0077 [-0.0234, +0.0080] incomplete (1 of 3 seeds), no verdict; wide1 - ctrl -0.0009 [-0.0104, +0.0083] incomplete (2 of 3 seeds), no verdict; wide - wide1 -0.0080 [-0.0219, +0.0060] incomplete (1 of 3 seeds), no verdict; ctrl - untouched +0.1673 [+0.1444, +0.1903] incomplete (2 of 3 seeds), no verdict; wide - untouched +0.1594 [+0.1350, +0.1841] incomplete (1 of 3 seeds), no verdict; wide1 - untouched +0.1677 [+0.1446, +0.1916] effect, positive; ctrl - warmup +0.0578 [+0.0418, +0.0738] incomplete (2 of 3 seeds), no verdict; wide - warmup +0.0499 [+0.0318, +0.0681] incomplete (1 of 3 seeds), no verdict; wide1 - warmup +0.0582 [+0.0431, +0.0741] effect, positive; warmup - untouched +0.1095 [+0.0916, +0.1278] descriptive. PARTIAL: 6 of 9 arm runs present (ctrl seeds 0/1, wide seeds 0, wide1 seeds 0/1/2); redrawn as runs finish, no arm verdict until 3 seeds per arm.

Validation slice (500 held-out GSM8K train items x 2 samples, one GPU for every model): accuracy against the mean reasoning tokens each model actually spent at each budget, so a curve further left at the same height reasons less for the same accuracy. Natural length (mean reasoning tokens at 8,192) and budget to reach the untouched model's 8k accuracy (0.798): untouched 5730 tokens, cut off 0.467; warm-up 3947, cut off 0.222, reaches the untouched 8k accuracy at 275; ctrl 1735, cut off 0.046, reaches it at 256; wide 828, cut off 0.013, reaches it at 256; wide1 1412, cut off 0.035, reaches it at 256. PARTIAL: 6 of 9 arm runs present (ctrl seeds 0/1, wide seeds 0, wide1 seeds 0/1/2); redrawn as runs finish, no arm verdict until 3 seeds per arm.
